trust_decision.summary: Whether an agent is free for [slot start, start+duration) is decided by a plain SELECT on appointment and agent_absence in ensureAgentIsAvailableForSlot, outside any transaction or lock; the INSERT follows as a separate statement, so two concurrent bookings both pass the check.

landing_point.why: Both handlers named in the summary call ensureAgentIsAvailableForSlot right before inserting; it is the only overlap check in the service.

fix_sites.entry_point: POST /api/tenants/{id}/appointments/add-to-tunnel (src/routes/api/tenants/[id]/appointments/add-to-tunnel/+server.ts:259-296), also staff-create for existing clients
POST /api/tenants/{id}/appointments/create-new-client (src/routes/api/tenants/[id]/appointments/create-new-client/+server.ts:302-325), also staff-create for new clients
private helper reached from both methods above

O3_reason_to_dismiss: Absence create/update (agent-service.ts) is a staff-only admin feature in a different service; the advisory talks about overlapping appointments only, so a solver can argue absences are out of scope even though the booking check reads agent_absence.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Back-to-back slots (strict lt/gt bounds) must still book; a slot freed by cancel (status REJECTED) must be bookable again; different agents can book the same time. A global table lock, a unique index on (agent_id, appointment_date), or counting REJECTED rows breaks one of these.

O6_input_shapes: existing-client booking (add-to-tunnel) vs new-client booking (create-new-client, inside tunnel-creation transaction)
exact-same start vs partially overlapping interval of different duration

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Absence create runs its own check-then-insert with no lock and never reads appointments, so it can land inside a booking that is concurrently passing the absence half of ensureAgentIsAvailableForSlot; a per-agent lock taken only by the booking paths leaves this open.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Staff-only absence management; the advisory says overlapping appointments, not absences.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different service file (agent-service.ts) from the landing point, same package

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Absence update moves the dates using the same unlocked overlap-check-then-update pattern, again without checking or locking against appointments.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Absence-vs-absence overlap is a separate feature, and updates are not creation.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a staff reschedule/'move appointment' method that updates appointmentDate/duration/agentId after calling ensureAgentIsAvailableForSlot outside a transaction
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the service already has status-update methods, and a reschedule feature would naturally reuse the existing helper

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a separate bulk/series staff booking that inserts several appointments directly with tx.insert after one availability check
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: staff-create already branches between two service paths, and a recurring-series feature is a plausible extension

O9_family: Race condition / TOCTOU (CWE-367) on a business invariant (no double booking per agent)

O10_build.toolchain: Node + SvelteKit (@sveltejs/kit ^2.65), Vite, drizzle-orm ^0.45 with postgres-js ^3.4, vitest ^4, playwright for e2e
services: PostgreSQL (central DB plus a database per tenant, src/lib/server/db/index.ts:14-46)
O10_build.project_tests: vitest unit tests mock the DB entirely (src/lib/server/services/__tests__/appointment-service.test.ts:7, add-to-tunnel/__tests__, create-new-client/__tests__, staff-create/__tests__), so they cannot exercise real concurrency. Behavioural race tests need a live Postgres.

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Move ensureAgentIsAvailableForSlot into db.transaction at the default READ COMMITTED level without a lock (still races), or add a unique index on (agent_id, appointment_date), which misses partial overlaps and blocks rebooking after a cancel.

out_of_scope_notes: add-to-tunnel and create-new-client call consumeBookingAccessToken only after the booking succeeds (add-to-tunnel/+server.ts:366, create-new-client/+server.ts:327): a token-reuse race in a separate check-then-use pair (cf. commit da921eb).
ensureAgentIsAvailableForSlot does not check that agentId belongs to channelId or is non-archived (appointment-service.ts:114-171).
denyAppointment issues an un-awaited delete after the update (appointment-service.ts:360-374).
